cn.t: Critics find Akhtar's AI-themed play muddled and frustrating despite Downey Jr.'s magnetic Broadway debut. The production dazzles technically but fails to meaningfully grapple with its weighty themes, leaving audiences intellectually intrigued yet emotionally cold.
